purpose: Teach: 内戦/銃撃/ラテン語/追い出さ/置き去り/煽っ/潰さ/吸い込ま

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、海外内戦の関係者かと警察、調査中です
lines.en: We're currently investigating whether this case is connected to overseas civil conflict actors.
lines.style: Professional, measured briefing tone. Even cadence. Opens with quiet authority. Clinical precision—no dramatization. The voice of someone who has delivered difficult information many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、銃撃事件の発生時刻、警察、特定されたんですね
lines.en: So the time of the shooting has been pinpointed by the investigation, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful inquiry, leaning forward slightly. Genuine curiosity—not challenging. A pause after the opening before the question lands. The tone of someone piecing something together.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ラテン語の暗号を解読中です
lines.en: The investigation is currently working on deciphering a Latin cipher left at the scene.
lines.style: Steady, factual delivery. Slight emphasis on the unusual detail—'Latin'—with clinical interest. No speculation, just the facts. Measured pace throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が組織を追い出された経緯、警察、把握ですね
lines.en: So the background on how the suspect was expelled from the organization has been established?
lines.style: Quieter, connecting the threads aloud. Thoughtful pacing. A hint of recognition—understanding the motive now. Slightly hesitant, like he's checking his own deduction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場に置き去りにされた被害者を救助しました
lines.en: The team recovered a victim who had been left at the scene.
lines.style: Factual, measured. A slight weight on 'recovered'—acknowledgment of what was saved. Even tone, but the words themselves carry the gravity. No embellishment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、SNSで群衆を煽った投稿、警察、調査中ですね
lines.en: There were social media posts inciting the crowd that are currently under investigation.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Connecting another thread. Slight emphasis on 'social media' as a vector. Professional, but the implication of coordinated manipulation hangs in the air.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織を潰さねばなりません
lines.en: The investigation must dismantle this criminal organization.
lines.style: Firmer resolve here. A lift on 'must'—conviction entering the measured tone. Still professional, but this is a statement of necessary action, not mere reporting. Eye-contact steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、排水溝に吸い込まれた証拠物を警察、回収されたんですね
lines.en: Evidence that was drawn into the drainage system has been recovered by the investigation, then?
lines.style: Quiet synthesis of the investigation's persistence. Trailing slightly on the final particle—trailing thought becoming affirmation. A final piece clicking into place. Slight awe at thoroughness.
